title: Encrypted Sync
description: Merge your local-first data across devices through your own WebDAV or S3 storage. Everything is encrypted before it leaves this browser.
offlineBoundary: You are offline. Sync, provider changes, vault setup, imports, key rotation, and conflict decisions are unavailable until this device reconnects.
operationFailed: The sync operation failed. Please try again.
storageHealthDescription: Read-only diagnostics compare persisted chat and knowledge file references with the files currently present in browser storage. Nothing is deleted.
backupFreshnessUnavailable: Unavailable: backup creation time is not persisted. Create a backup from System settings when needed.
deviceSecurityPlanned: Planned, but not currently available. Devices shown below cannot yet be revoked individually, and vault keys cannot be rotated in place.
providerDescription: Credentials stay encrypted on this device and are used only for the current proxy request.
forcePathStyle: Use path-style S3 URLs (recommended for MinIO)
replaceCredentialHint: Enter credentials again to replace the encrypted copy.
vaultDescription: The recovery code is the only way to decrypt this vault on another device. Neo Chat cannot recover it for you.
saveRecoveryWarning: Save this recovery code before activating sync. Anyone with it can decrypt your vault.
recoveryQrAlt: QR code containing this sync recovery code
recoveryQrLoading: Creating the recovery QR code on this device…
recoveryQrError: The recovery QR code could not be created. Save the text code instead.
recoverySavedConfirmation: I saved this recovery code somewhere safe.
newVaultHint: This rotates the key and remote namespace. Neo Chat never deletes orphaned or previous-vault objects automatically; remove the old vault in WebDAV or S3 only after every device has migrated.
recoveryCodeHint: Paste the complete neo-sync-v1 recovery code. Its checksum is verified before anything is stored.
noDevices: Devices appear after the first successful sync.
conflictsDescription: Messages and entities merge automatically. Choose a value only for scalar settings changed concurrently.
disableHint: Remote encrypted objects are retained. Disabling sync does not delete your local data or the remote vault.
